title: D7 agent output (d7-latest-answer-checker)
description: Section 12/D7 'Agent output' line and .claude/agents/d7-latest-answer-checker.md's worked output shape: {"latest_answer", "same_as_official", "quote", "change_id", "sentence_for_note", "note"}. Checks that need the per-item input context — the quote verified in the LATEST edition, change_id existing and covering an evidence passage (spec 12/D7 Checks), same_as_official agreeing with latest_answer vs the official answer, and the sentence_for_note template — live in scripts/checks/D7.py. D7's INPUT is restricted by spec Rule 10 ('B6 never sees the key; B6 and D7 never see coaching material'); that restriction is enforced in code by step_plugins.D7Plugin._build_input's explicit allowlist plus lib/coaching_guard.guard_d7_input, not by convention.

latest_answer.description: The option the LATEST NCERT supports, decided only from the latest lines given (d7-latest-answer-checker.md Allowed values).

same_as_official.description: Whether that is the same option as the official answer. false always raises D7_ANSWER_CHANGED (high) and re-runs D4 for the new answer (spec 12/D7 On failure).

quote.description: The latest-edition line that decides it, copied exactly. Verified word-for-word against the latest passages in scripts/checks/D7.py; may be empty only when latest_answer is 'unsure'.

change_id.description: The change-log entry that explains a changed answer, from the entries given. null when none of them explains it — in which case `note` must say so (the agent file's own rule) and the plugin raises D7_UNEXPLAINED_CHANGE (high).

sentence_for_note.description: The extra sentence appended to D6's reason note, in the agent file's own template: 'By the older NCERT the answer was (<official>); by the latest NCERT it is (<latest>).' Empty string when same_as_official is true.

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
